source.author: Myshko, A.
source.title: МЕТАМОНИЗМ Глава 2. Продолжение актуализации: диссипация тождества, возникновение пространственности и временности и ортогональное разрешение

active_chain.claim: Ban of Indifference is the single foundational invariant.
Dissipation of identity is the first necessary consequence.
Continuation produces a sequence of distinct states.
Temporality and spatiality arise as forms of continuation.
Directionality is required by non-identical continuation.
Indefinite continuation along an already actualized direction risks contentual exhaustion.
Continuation therefore requires logically independent continuation.
When the current mode is exhausted, continuation requires orthogonal resolution.
Concrete orthogonal resolution is defined by preserving prior structure and avoiding coincidence.
A specific concrete geometry such as equidistance is not established as unique.
Chapter 3 may instantiate the general resolution as P3→P4 with +n→-n.

frontiers: formalize processual orthogonal resolution without importing a metric
compare Chapter 2 general mechanism with Chapter 3 P3→P4
only then test operator algebra and Clifford compatibility
